value.rationale: The 12-vertex 24-edge Chvátal graph is a canonical triangle-free regular four-chromatic example. Its natural ordinary matching complex unexpectedly has integral order-three torsion; the complete homotopy classification identifies a Moore summand and 28 spheres. This contrasts mathematically with the torsion-free Grötzsch matching complex and is invisible to rational Betti numbers, providing motivated nontrivial topology beyond a routine numerical invariant.
